meta.title: Flocon Resort
meta.stack: Three.js, React Three Fiber, GSAP, Next.js

overview: Flocon Resort delivers an interactive 3D digital hospitality environment rendered through high-performance WebGL viewports.
The architectural experience merges procedural canvas dynamics with GPU-accelerated spatial camera choreography.
details: React Three Fiber coordinates isolated 3D scene graphs with declarative component lifecycles.
Custom Three.js shader materials simulate winter atmospheric illumination with strict frame-budget conservation.
GSAP timelines synchronize camera orbits, lighting states, and spatial text reveals without layout trashing.
Canvas Confetti effects execute particle simulations during key interaction waypoints.

overview: Vintage Camera BD establishes an archival database and marketplace platform dedicated to analog cameras and mechanical optics.
The system integrates high-efficiency Next.js App Router streaming with relational persistence across complex horological metadata.
details: Next.js App Router renders static product sheets on edge servers with incremental cache invalidation.
PostgreSQL database schemas maintain relational integrity across lens specifications, shutter formats, and historical production eras.
Custom PL/pgSQL database functions accelerate multi-attribute filtering and text indexing across vintage inventory.
Typed data contracts ensure zero runtime schema mismatches between administrative catalog inputs and client browsing surfaces.
